+    def _is_all_any_call(self, node):
+        """Check if node is a call to all() or any()."""
+        return (
+            isinstance(node, ast.Call)
+            and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
+            and node.func.id in ("all", "any")
+            and len(node.args) == 1
+            and not node.keywords
+        )
+
+    def _is_comprehension(self, node):
+        """Check if node is a generator expression or comprehension."""
+        return isinstance(node, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp))
+
+    def _unroll_all_any(self, call, assert_lineno, assert_col_offset):
+        """Unroll all/any call into a for loop with assertions.
+        
+        This transforms:
+            assert all(predicate(x) for x in items)
+        Into:
+            for x in items:
+                assert predicate(x)
+        """
+        func_name = call.func.id
+        arg = call.args[0]
+        
+        if not self._is_comprehension(arg):
+            return None
+        
+        # For now, we only support single-level comprehensions
+        if len(arg.generators) != 1:
+            return None
+        
+        gen = arg.generators[0]
+        
+        # We don't support comprehensions with filters for now
+        if gen.ifs:
+            return None
+        
+        # Create the assert statement
+        assert_stmt = ast.Assert(arg.elt, None)
+        
+        # Create the for loop
+        for_loop = ast.For(gen.target, gen.iter, [assert_stmt], [])
+        
+        # Set line numbers
+        set_location(for_loop, assert_lineno, assert_col_offset)
+        set_location(assert_stmt, assert_lineno, assert_col_offset)
+        
+        return for_loop
+
